author: Arhan Canli
purpose: The conditions that must all hold before any real capital is placed with a broker for any ALPHAC sleeve. Until every criterion passes the only permitted trading is the existing paper trading. Proposed 2026-09-24 for the owner's execution pillar; thresholds marked proposed are the owner's to change.

criteria.rule: forward daily return observations >= the contract's establishment minimum
forward Sharpe point estimate exists and is >= the owner's governing target
realized live max drawdown <= the owner's realized bound
the forward record's provenance gate passes
current sleeves in the book >= the owner's sleeve goal
every sleeve's measured implementation shortfall is <= max_shortfall_bps (proposed 25 bp of decision notional)
the drawdown control contract is active on the live path
daily broker-to-ledger reconciliation with zero unexplained differences for 60 consecutive sessions
trading keys held outside the repository with least privilege, and a tested kill switch that flattens and halts every sleeve
an adult-controlled legal entity or account holder able to contract with a broker; the owner is a minor and cannot hold these agreements alone

qualified counsel confirms the regulatory position before managing any money that is not the account holder's own (in the UAE the regulator depends on the location: DFSA, FSRA or SCA); this document is not legal advice
